why: The SPAN is half the rule and the easiest half to drop, because dropping it leaves a tree that still holds a plan, still falls back, and still passes any test that only checks which angle came out. What it removes is the commitment: the plan would turn over on EVERY tick its preferred type has no solution, which is the churn issue #332 exists to stop -- teal would flip back and forth for as long as the player stayed behind cover. Deleting the `lapsed &&` term must fail a test, or the profile field is decorative.
killedBy: teal shot-plan span (issue #332) an UNSOLVABLE plan inside a live span does NOT turn over -- the countdown is what gates it
